# Repodoc

Welcome to repodoc! We are super excited you guys are here and we think you will love it.

## Quickstart

First run `repodoc init` and then run `repodoc build` to generate your docs. The tool watches your files and rebuilds automatically when anything changes, which is really convenient for large projects with many contributors working at the same time across different time zones and build setups.
